description: Bushfire Last Resort Refuges is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by SA Country Fire Service. A Bushfire Last Resort Refuge is intended to provide a place of relative safety during a bushfire. It does not guarantee the survival of those who assemble there. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher SA Country Fire Service. Its tags are bushfire, community, emergency, evacuation, fire. It offers 5 resource(s) in geojson, html, kml, map viewer, shp. The portal shows 2023-08-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivs. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
